intro.text: Sureshot Glasses drop from Alien generals. But in case you're tired of farming them, there's a way to build them.

steps.text: Now it's time to put everything together:

details.text: At start of guide we said you'll need at least QL 100 Crystalline Disk. Why? Simply because Sureshot Glasses come in quality range of 100-300. Another thing to watch while making them is title requirement to wear (QL 100-119 for tlt1, 120-159 for tlt2, 160-199 for tlt3, 200-239 for tlt4, 240-279 for tlt5, 280+ for tlt6).
